brief:
Settlers launched an attack on homes belonging to Palestinian residents in the town of Beita, located south of Nablus in the West Bank, on Sunday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The assault targeted multiple residential structures in the village.

Details on the scale of the operation and the identities of those targeted remained limited in initial reports. No immediate information was available regarding injuries or the extent of property damage sustained in the incident.
